label: Transform
description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression against the previous step's output and returns the result.

expression.description: A JavaScript expression evaluated with `output` (previous step data) and `previousOutputs` (all prior step outputs) in scope. The expression's return value becomes `result`.

fromStep.description: Optional step name whose output is bound to `output`. Defaults to the most recently completed step.

result.description: The value produced by the expression. The actual runtime type depends on what the expression returns (string, number, boolean, object, array, etc.).
